chain_rebuild: Chain status must be reconstructible from immutable chain plan, events, per-level run records, parent certificates and catalog manifests.
controller_checkpoint: After each level transition and parent commit, write a chain checkpoint containing chain state, current parent certificate SHA and cumulative resource totals.

corruption.repair: explicitly authorized repair under recorded new attempt or new source identity

crash_recovery.missing_heartbeat: insufficient by itself to steal a live lock
crash_recovery.same_host_dead_pid: auditable recovery allowed only after verifying process is absent and lock metadata matches chain/run

reuse: Reuse only byte-verified checkpoints whose plan, source, environment, stage/chunk specification, inputs and dependency bindings all match.
stale_downstream: Never reuse downstream work if an upstream output/dependency binding changes.
